statement.heading: Drowning in information you can't recall?
statement.body1: PDFs and notes scattered across folders, never findable when you need them. AI tools that answer without ever seeing what you've saved. kioku gathers your materials in one place, and the AI works from what you've actually uploaded.
statement.body2: Capture knowledge well, and actually use it.

synthesis.title: Organize with folders
synthesis.body: Keep PDFs, notes, and text files neatly organized in projects and nested folders. One place for everything — lectures, research, or personal study.

library.title: Chat with your materials
library.body: Ask the AI questions grounded in your project files. Summarize a paper, rephrase a chapter, or dig into the details — all based on what you've actually uploaded.

research.title: AI-generated podcasts
research.body: Select any files and let AI turn them into an audio explanation. Get a podcast-style summary in minutes — perfect for reviewing on the go.

cta.title: Scale your knowledge potential.
cta.body: Join thousands of professionals using kioku to capture, connect, and recall everything that matters.
